name: Real-Time Provider Health
tagline: Dynamically adapt when provider availability changes during a run.
brief: Route to Provider A while online, then fallback to Provider B when Provider A drops.
context: Provider A starts online, but drops mid-run. Provider B remains online continuously.
narrative:
Static routing breaks when provider health changes mid-run!

In this challenge, Provider A starts online and offers optimal rates, but drops offline halfway through processing the queue. Provider B remains online throughout.

Set up dynamic routing: send transactions to Provider A while onlineA is true, and fall back to Provider B (onlineB) when Provider A drops.
objective: Process every payment with at most one failure while provider health changes.
learningObjective: Build dynamic fallbacks that adapt to live environmental state changes and provider outages.
intelligenceExplanation:
Order rules dynamically:
1. WHEN onlineA -> DO route-a
2. WHEN onlineB -> DO route-b

While A is online, rule 1 fires. When A goes offline mid-run, rule 1 fails to match and rule 2 seamlessly takes over.
hint: Place WHEN onlineA -> DO route-a above WHEN onlineB -> DO route-b.
hints: Place WHEN onlineA -> DO route-a first.
Place WHEN onlineB -> DO route-b second as a fallback.
